definitions.setting: Zero to m-1 unread sharp site copies between the m two-tick opposite-rail records. Fixed mask and a localized physical sheet of order M; uniform Fourier weights.
definitions.quantity: S sums unnormalized word probabilities over all M signed charges. Original-sheet probability is S/M.
definitions.cuts: Bit i-1 copies the site after block i; the last-only control instead copies after the final successful block.
definitions.multiplicity: Rows [sorted segment lengths, number of ordered masks, integer numerator of S, absolute difference of independent trigonometric sum]. These rows encode every ordered composition, including all ties in S.
definitions.maxima: Global and cut-count maxima and ties use exact integers. Per folded charge one numerical maximizer is given; exact ties between partitions there are not resolved.
definitions.refinement: A pass at each block fixes its final rail. The complete history sign is (-1) to the number of middle L hops, fixed by terminal x. An additional site pointer separates same-sign sums in the localized sheet. Every additive single split of every partition is checked, including repeated parts and both split orders.
definitions.correlated_rival: The units alone copy every internal boundary. Exogenous comparison copies every boundary with probability 2/M, independently of sector, or uses iid per-boundary bits with that same rate. The first comparison agrees under ALL zero-field forced masks. Sector-dependent copies require access to the charge or an initially correlated apparatus.
definitions.final_copy: Expectation of the incident successful coherent-state projector after a final unread copy equals the sum of squared normalized position probabilities. An additional native opposite-rail switch also probes the change.
definitions.limits: Finite fixed-order data. No threshold constant or asymptotic rate is fitted.
